title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode4 A Blessed Costume

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Airi, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I... I don't believe it...!
She's like a prince...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-She's...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's become a lethal weapon...!!
Her amazing looks are too overwhelming...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't you get it?! We're saying that it suits you way too well!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It does? Thank you, Airi!
Those dresses suit you both very well too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I still think I pale in comparison to you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That tuxedo looks incredible by itself, but you wearing it makes it look just that much more stunning... It's like you're putting your model powers on full display!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I alone wouldn't have been able to make this tuxedo seem so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ms. Kinuya told me so herself.
This costume is imbued with the hope that “the wearer can feel a genuine sense of happiness.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That thought is likely what's giving me the ability to shine brighter than usual.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That thought...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Ms. Kinuya did everything for us this time around... But the efforts of the hairstylists, makeup artists, costume designers and such are usually what make what we do a reality.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not just about the ones in the spotlight. A lot of people have to work together to give that person a captivating charm. That's true whether you're a model or an idol!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see... That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, An should be just about ready too.
They were just putting the finishing touches on her hair.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to see her...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Wow...! Shizuku looks so cool...!
I knew it. Real models just have something the rest of us don't...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
Am I really gonna look okay as her partner?)

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: An, what are you stopping at the entrance for? C'mon, this way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Um, right...!

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
E-Everyone, I'm ready...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An!
How's the dress...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my. Isn't she lovely...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That dress and tiara look so good on you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've never worn such a fancy dress before and was worried that I wouldn't be able to play a bride very well... So I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You're...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's wrong, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're so beautiful, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Cute, beautiful and...!
Gorgeous beyond belief!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, Kohane, I get it! I look pretty!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But thanks!
You look really pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
I'm done setting up everything for the shoot and... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
You all look spectacular!
Yes, absolutely perfect!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
So, let's start the shoot.
Please come join me in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yikes! I stepped on the hem!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, at this rate, I'm gonna fall...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you okay, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Shizuku?!
Y-Your face... It's so close...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I thought you were about to fall, so I jumped in to help...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one apologizing!
I accidentally stepped on the hem...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
More importantly, An, are you hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-I'm okay...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
Our much-awaited wedding would've been all for naught if our bride were to get injured.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'm really glad you're okay, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wh-Whoa...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The prince saved the princess! It's straight out of a fairytale...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I get why she'd be overwhelmed...
Shizuku kinda has a habit of getting up close and personal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Alright, An, shall we?
Why don't we lock arms on our way over?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It might be because she's in a dress, but An seems to be acting a little different than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, that reminds me of what she said...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like you, MEIKO!
She seemed so beautiful, mature and collected!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Is that what's going on...?
Hehe. You're so adorable, An...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Geez, talk about a surprise!
My heart's racing because Shizuku's so pretty and literally right next to me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(She's so amazing...
So mature and can pull off something like a tux.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, that means I've gotta do my best too...!)
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we start by taking some photos of the bride and the bridesmaids.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Bridesmaids are supposed to assist the bride, but they're also usually the bride's closest friends. You don't necessarily have to pose like we're taking formal wedding photos.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I'd rather have you all smile and have fun together in a way that shows others the moment when “happiness brings everybody together”!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow, the shoot's really about to start...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(A-Am I gonna be okay...?
Shizuku looks so cool, and An and Airi both look really adorable... Plus, I'm not used to having anyone other than Dad take photos of me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, are you pretty nervous about this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Um... Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I really like taking photos, but I'm really not used to actually being in them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, I get that.
It's not that I dislike this or anything, but I'm a little nervous too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You'll be fine, Kohane!
Just smile!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right!
Okay...! Smile... Smile...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A-Are we gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin with a few test shots! First, Airi, mind holding An's hand for me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
An, ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, that's good! You two seem like old friends. Next, Kohane, can you take Airi's spot for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've got this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-After I take her hand... What sort of expression should I be making...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
You could try remembering a time when An looked visibly happy and you felt really glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
When I felt glad for her...?
B-But that's happened so much...
I don't know which memory to go with...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you're such a straight arrow.
It's okay, just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Not to mention that it's your first time being a model. How about we take some photos with just you to get you used to being in front of the lens?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kohane seems a bit tense.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I hope she finds a way to shake those nerves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if we did some stretches or something else that can help her relax a little...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Relax, huh...?
Oh, An, can I borrow you for a sec?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka mentioned how you two are really close. If that's true, why not...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...is what I wanna try.
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I see...
Okay! Let's give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh dear. You seem more nervous when you're by yourself. I apologize for asking so much of you.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Let's try taking these a different way.
Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No... My face is totally freezing up...!
I have to find a way to smile fast...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But how...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, Ms. Kawasaki!
Would it be alright if the three of us tried doing this pose we like together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have a feeling that it'll look more natural, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand...
Okay, I don't mind you doing this pose of yours.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay... Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! Wh-What's going on, Airi?
Why are you hugging An all of a sudden...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After discussing things with An, we decided to literally get closer to each other!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! And now we look like best friends!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh... What say you, Kohane?!
Are you gonna let me hog An all to myself?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Congratulations, An!
You getting married really brings a tear to my eye...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And close it out by really squeezing her tight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Th-Thank you, Airi!
I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... S-So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Kohane, go get her!
This might be your last chance ever to hug her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-My last chance...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But... Noooo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wah! Ko-Kohane... You're crushing me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, no fair!
I'm not letting you have all the fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You have such a beautiful smile on your face now, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes, your smiles are so lovely...!
I can sense your exuberance from here!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Just keep that going while I take a few more shots!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
We must've gotten in a year's worth of hugs just now♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But it was kind of embarrassing too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Kohane, the expressions you made were so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about surprising you like that, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we believed that it was the best way to get you to relax a little more, so we decided to have some fun to lighten things up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay! I feel so much more relaxed because of what you did, Airi! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
In that case, great!
There really is nothing better than when everyone's smiling!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Kohane found a way to relax. I feel a lot better now compared to earlier too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And the way Airi lightened up the mood in a flash was so incredible... It's like proof that she's really an idol!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, I have to keep this up and get in some good shots with Shizuku!)

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: Meow...
se_event_happiness_2022_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Did a cat just meow?
Is it the same cat from before?

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Oh, I heard from the staff here that some cats have taken up residence around this hall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Everyone, let's move to our next location!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, be right there!!
se_event_happiness_2022_004
